shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing; §32 pathing cost; §33 cross-level drafted movement. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~81 files, ~25,300 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: SHIPPED, OPEN BETA, BACK IN BUILD MODE.** Published 2026-08-01 as **Workshop item 3776015553** (public). Folder fully restored, `build_mod` green. See §31.

**⚠ THE VERIFICATION TABLE WAS RE-BASED 2026-08-01.** The user tested the 190/254 tiers, all 15 utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop router **outside Modmixer**. §9's run log records agent-driven runs ONLY and is an INCOMPLETE record.

**The standing risk.** §29's depth cut ships ON, judged by eye only. **Any performance report on a mountainous map: throw `MassDepthCutEnabled` first.**

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED. **✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** All three tiers exercised.
**✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.**
**✅ §32b DOOR/PAWN BAND SCOPE VERIFIED IN PLAY (#294)** - 50.0% of door writes, 14.3% of pawn checks skipped on a 5-band map.
**✅ §33b DRAFTED CROSS-LEVEL ORDERS VERIFIED IN PLAY (#295)** - "drafted across two levels works". The upward force-move bug is CLOSED.
**🔧 §33a PATH LINE: two bugs found and fixed after #295, UNVERIFIED.** Reversed leg order + hop segments drawn. **User reported it still buggy; the reversal is a confirmed cause but may not be the only one - ASK WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE before assuming it is closed.**
**🔧 §33c STAIR ANIMATION REDESIGNED AFTER #295 (never played), UNVERIFIED.**
**🔧 §8b, §25, §30a BUILT, UNVERIFIED.**
**🔧 §32a CROSS-BAND REJECTION LIVE BUT NEVER FIRED** - needs a raid.
**🔧 §32c HEURISTIC SLIDER SHIPS AT 1.00 (OFF), UNEXERCISED.**
**🎨 ART: 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders. DISCLOSED. THE HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED. **Same downward-only asymmetry as §33b, which is now a worked example of the fix.**

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS.** `RegionLink` is read by the region graph and NOTHING else; every power/pipe system builds from raw CELL ADJACENCY (§30).

**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION.** `AB_OpenAir` declares **no affordances**.

**⚠ THE GUTTER IS ALSO UNPATHABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, INCLUDING FOR FLYING PAWNS.** `AB_OpenAir` is `Impassable` and does NOT set `forcePassableByFlyingPawns`, the only exemption `PathGrid.CalculatedCostAt` honours for `PathGridDef Flying`. A band is a sealed pocket for every traversal mode. §32 depends on this.

**⚠ THE MOD IS DOWNWARD-ONLY IN THREE PLACES - ONE DESIGN DECISION WEARING THREE COSTUMES.** `TryResolveVisibleBelow` descends; the see-through click rule only subtracts (`clickPos.z - drop`); the combat renderer only draws down. Every "X does not work upward" report traces here. **§33b fixed the click case by adding the VIEW BAND as a second input, and that is the template** - the combat case (§13 item 2) is the same shape and still open.

**Hard 1.6 constraints.** No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Pathfinder cost: **§32**.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, nine shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview; GL grids; Rimefeller oil | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes | GL landform lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |
| **Whole-map list sweep** (§32) | every door / every pawn, per path request | bucket the list per band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP** (`slot - 2`: 62, 126, 190, 254, 318). Anchoring 190 *determined* the rest.
**⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN** - the confound §30a walked into is gone.
**⚠ WHAT WAS GIVEN UP.** 250/300 were vanilla Medium/Large exactly. **318 is blocked by arithmetic.** **62 is deliberately absent** (`SeamMarginFor` takes 13%). **The wide gutter was real safety and is gone.**
**⚠ THE BUDGET'S STATED JUSTIFICATION WAS PARTLY WRONG - THE BUDGET ITSELF IS NOT.** See §32.
**⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - gutter 56, 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.**

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception (`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`); hops strictly decrease.
**⚠ TWO CARRY TRIGGERS EXIST AND THEY MUST ALWAYS AGREE:** the per-tick sweep and `PatherArrived`. When they disagreed, whether a transit completed depended on which fired first. **Anything gating a carry must gate BOTH** (§33c).
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; NINE appearances of the single-step bug.
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER.** **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ MASS FILL IS EMITTED FROM THREE PLACES.** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL**.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 8b. THE DEPTH SHRINK — SCOPE IS LOOSE CONTENTS ONLY
`ABDepthView` is the ONE definition (`ScaleForLevels`, 60-100%, default 85%). Consumers: the printed mesh (`SectionLayer_ABBelowV2`) and the realtime pawn pass (`Patch_PawnRenderer_ABBelowShrink`).
**⚠ BUILDINGS DO NOT SHRINK. `CanShrink` IS AN ALLOW-LIST ON `ThingDef.category`:** Item, Plant, Filth. **Pawns take the realtime path and DO shrink.**
**⚠ THE REASON IS THAT TERRAIN IS NEVER SHRUNK.** A shrunken building no longer fits its footprint and reads as *wrong size*, not distance. HARD rule.
**⚠ THE `linkType` TEST IS KEPT** - mods ship linked PLANTS and ITEMS.
**⚠ THE PAWN MATRIX NOW CARRIES TWO EFFECTS (§33c) AND THEY MULTIPLY IN ONE POSTFIX.** Do not add a second `[HarmonyPatch]` on `GetDrawParms`.

# 9. GENERATION COST
**9a.** The profile stamps its own conditions (`TILE`, `PLAN`, `SCOPING:`, two censuses, bisect state). Has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**

**⚠ THE TABLE RECORDS AGENT-DRIVEN RUNS ONLY.**
**OLD LADDER**: #231 7x126 ~5.7 s | #236 3x250 ~12.4 s | #237 5x190 ~6.9 s | #255 5x190 Boreal **~4.1 s** | #259/#260 +Caves ~5.3/5.8 s.
**NEW LADDER** (146,000, all 5x126): #276 Flat TempForest rain 1327 ~2.9 s | #277 LargeHills +Caves +River ~3.4 s | #278 Flat ExtremeDesert rain 158 **~1.6 s** | #279 LargeHills ~2.8 s | **#294/#295 Mountainous ExtremeDesert rain 139 ~3.1 s** (carve 1,998 ms, **1,575 of it `FillRock band 0`**).
**⚠ THE NEW LADDER'S WHOLE RANGE SITS BELOW THE OLD LADDER'S BEST.**
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size** and dominates a mountainous tile.
**⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`** - a 21x spread on the same plan.
**⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED TO A RANGE.** n=2 was not a pattern.
**⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING TEST IS VALID AT ALL.**
**⚠ `Pathing.RecalculateAllPerceivedPathCosts` RUNS AT EVERY `Map.FinalizeInit`, ONCE PER `PathGridDef` WITH A WORKER** - 3 x NumGridCells managed `CalculatedCostAt` calls on generation AND save load (inside #294's 73.7 ms FinalizeInit).

**9g. RE-RANKED ON EVIDENCE.** 1. **Basement rock suppression** (~1.0-4.3 s, tile-independent). 2. `GenStep_Plants` (rainfall-driven, demoted). 3. `GenStep_RockChunks`. 4. Ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS, AND THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.**
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=20.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR PROFILE / BISECT / RISER / PATHING lines arrive as `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US** - a run reporting only those is CLEAN. **Info is filtered out of the bridge.**
**⚠ A CLEAN RUN STILL PROVES ONE THING: no `Skipped patch class` warning means every `[HarmonyPatch]` resolved its target** - including string-named private methods and `FieldRefAccess` fields. That is the cheapest confirmation available and it is free on every launch.
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.**
**⚠ INSTRUMENT BEFORE THE THIRD GUESS.**
**⚠ TWO COUNTERS IN DIFFERENT PATCHES THAT SHOULD TRACK 1:1 ARE A FREE CROSS-CHECK.** #294 read `guardCalls=433` vs `filterCalls=432` from unrelated patches on the same request stream. **Design counter pairs this way on purpose.**

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **ART.** 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders - a public promise now.
2. **CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT: upward shooting does not render.** **§33b is the worked example of the fix shape.**
3. **VERIFY §33a and §33c** - both reworked after #295 and unseen. **§33b is DONE.**
4. **VERIFY §8b, §30a, §25.**
5. **VERIFY §32a with a raid.** 6. **§32c slider is unexercised.**
7. **Basement rock suppression.** 8. **§30 polish:** `PipeGrid[P, cell]` not rewritten on merge (cosmetic).
9. §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; camera anchor; preview at 254.
10. **Never exercised:** basement PATHING, cavern basement.
11. §22 TABLED. 12. CAI 5000 (§26). 13. §30g. 14. §30e Rimefeller oil.
15. **Delete orphaned Workshop item 3773267907.** 16. **§32f.**

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the third theory** - and when there is none, BUILD ONE. A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** **Before writing an untested claim into player-facing copy, ASK.**
**⚠ A GUARD CLAUSE THAT SILENTLY EARLY-RETURNS IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN UNIMPLEMENTED FEATURE.**
**⚠ A PERFORMANCE CLAIM COPIED INTO THREE FILES IS STILL ONE UNVERIFIED CLAIM** (§32). **Duplication made it look corroborated.**
**⚠ A BURST-COMPILED METHOD CANNOT BE HARMONY PATCHED, AND FAILS SILENTLY.** `PathGridJob` and `PathFinderJob` are Burst structs. **Corollary: a job holding MANAGED references can never be Burst, so it IS patchable** - that is why `PathGridDoorsBlockedJob` was reachable.
**⚠ THE CHEAPEST OPTIMISATION IS DELETING WORK THAT CANNOT MATTER.**
**⚠ AN OVERLAY MUST AGREE WITH WHERE THE RENDERER PUTS THE THING, NOT WHERE THE THING IS** (§33a). **Ask which subsystem is the authority on the coordinate before choosing a frame of reference.**
**⚠ THREE COPIES OF ONE TRANSFORM, TWO OF THEM RIGHT.** The majority being correct is exactly why the odd one out survived. **A copy that is right is not evidence the others are.**
**⚠ A SYMPTOM CAN BE TWO DEFECTS WITH OPPOSITE FIXES** (§33a). **Count the defects before writing the patch** - either fix alone leaves the report standing and looks like a failed fix.
**⚠ AND THEN A THIRD.** §33a shipped with the leg order REVERSED on top of both. `PawnPath.Peek(n)` returns `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`, so ascending index runs FORWARD to the destination - vanilla's own DrawPath proves it by joining the pawn to `Peek(0)` then walking i upward. **When you copy a loop out of engine code, copy its DIRECTION too, and check it against a route that TURNS** - the bug is invisible on a straight corridor.
**⚠ A STATELESS EFFECT IS WORTH NOTHING IF THE STATE IT READS NEVER CHANGES** (§33c). The distance-driven shrink was designed to avoid delaying the teleport and could never play: `ArriveRadius` 3 against a shrink radius of 4 capped it at 0.25 progress for one tick. **Check the range your input can actually take before congratulating yourself on avoiding state.**
**⚠ "NEVER BLOCK" CAN BE THE WRONG SAFETY RULE. ASK HOW LONG, NOT WHETHER.** An 18-tick hold is shorter than opening a door and is bounded, self-cancelling and outlived by the existing 4000-tick timeout. **A risk argument without a magnitude is a superstition.**
**⚠ A VISUAL EFFECT IS ONLY CORRECT RELATIVE TO WHAT IT IS *NOT* APPLIED TO** (§8b).
**⚠ AN ASSUMPTION THAT TWO THINGS COINCIDE IS A CLAIM ABOUT A GUARANTEE - GO FIND IT.** The hop segment was left undrawn-by-accident on the theory that both anchors lift onto the same point. True for RISERS (partner cell is `(x, z +/- Slot)`), false for STAIRS, which pair arbitrarily. **A guarantee in one subsystem is not a guarantee in its neighbour.**
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.** **⚠ ASK HOW THE SUBSYSTEM REPRESENTS THE THING, NOT WHAT THE THING IS.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE.**
**⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.**
**⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.**
**⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS AND STILL LOOK CORRECT.**
**⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS LIKE THE MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.**
**⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4.**
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS - COUNT THE CODEBASES.**
**⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG.** **⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ GATE AGAINST THE HOST MOD'S OWN UNLOCK.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.**
**⚠ TWO CALL SITES OF ONE CONSTANT CAN NEED TWO DIFFERENT FIXES.**
**⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION THAT MOD WAS BUILT AGAINST.**
**⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT** - twice now: §33a's job-line localizer only needed its frame of reference corrected, and the "suppress vanilla and draw our own" proposal was already the shipped architecture.
**⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** **⚠ A DESIGN CHOICE RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COST WILL BE READ AS FREE.** **⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.**
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.**
**Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE method everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader** (§32: patch the Parameterize that assigns the lists, not the Execute that reads them). Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. **Never put a foreign type in a patch signature**; **when the offending parameter is a PRIVATE NESTED STRUCT, omit it - Harmony binds by name.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo".**
**⚠ REIMPLEMENT RATHER THAN POSTFIX WHEN THE GEOMETRY IS A CHAIN.** Job lines and the path line both build each segment from where the last ended.
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on `holdSnowOrSand=false` OR a Full-fillage edifice. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE.** A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during map generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper).** Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** **Vanilla rock links with `MapEdge`.** **`Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back to `_east` with `westFlipped`.**
**⚠ RENDERER FACTS THAT BIT TWICE.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18 a humanlike renders from a **cached atlas blit that ignores `PawnDrawParms.matrix`**, so any matrix effect silently evaporates at exactly the zoom players use - fix is `disableCache`. **`PawnRenderer.GetDrawParms` is reached from `ParallelPreDraw`, i.e. potentially on WORKER THREADS** - gate dictionary probes behind a plain int count. **`PawnDrawParms.pawn` gives you the pawn inside the postfix.** **A uniform x/z Scale commutes with the pawn's facing rotation so it can be right-multiplied; a TRANSLATION does not and must be left-multiplied to act in world space.**
**⚠ WALL-MOUNTED DRAW LAYER IS `Item`, NOT `BuildingOnTop`.** **⚠ SOUTH-FACING WALL MOUNTS NEED ZERO DRAW OFFSET WHILE N/E/W NEED 0.9.**
**⚠⚠ RIMWORLD HAS TWO UNRELATED "WALL-MOUNTED" MECHANISMS IN DIFFERENT CELLS.** `isAttachment` + `Placeworker_AttachedToWall` takes the OPEN cell BESIDE a wall and **the wall must declare `supportsWallAttachments` - ORDINARY COLONY WALLS DO NOT**. `canPlaceOverWall` + `PlaceWorker_OnWall` takes the WALL'S OWN cell - **what players mean**. **`isEdifice=false` + `clearBuildingArea=false` both load-bearing.**
**⚠ POWER FACTS.** `ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE; flood over `GenAdj.CellsAdjacentCardinal`. **`ConnectMaxDist = 6`** with NO line-of-sight check. **`Building.TransmitsPowerNow` is VIRTUAL and the base IGNORES flicking.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION.**
**⚠ PATHFINDER FACTS (§32).** `PathGridJob` is deduped through `gridJobLookup`, cleared every `PathFinderTick` - once per distinct VARIANT per tick, **and `Area`/`AvoidGrid` are part of that key**. `PathFinderJob.Execute` opens with `calcGrid.Clear()` over a 20-byte `CalcNode` per cell. `PathFinderTick` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`, so **no path job straddles a tick boundary**. `FindPathNow` is SYNCHRONOUS and ~10 vanilla JobGivers use it. `hCost = octile * 13 * heuristicStrength`; 1.0 is admissible, vanilla ships 1.75 for animals. **`PawnPath` is POOLED - copy nodes out and dispose.** **`Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`: ascending index runs FORWARD to the destination.**
**⚠ COLLECTION FACT THAT COST A SESSION.** **`HashSet<T>` implements `ICollection<T>` but NOT the non-generic `ICollection`.**
**⚠ TEXTURE FACTS.** **Core textures are PACKED.** **TWO art families**: Dubwise thick near-black outline; Vanilla/VE almost none. **Describe the SPRITE, not the object.**

# 30. CROSS-LEVEL UTILITY NETWORKS — ALL 15 LINK AND EXERCISED
**Junction** bridges one level UP *and* DOWN (60 steel + 2 components); **breaker** carries the switch (25 steel + 1). Both **go INSIDE a wall** (`canPlaceOverWall`) and **the pair must occupy the same cell** on adjacent bands. Names are thematic per network; **defNames are save keys and never change.**
**⚠ THE SPLIT IS PRESENTATIONAL, NOT A FLOW DIRECTION** - once paired the networks MERGE and pool.

# 33. CROSS-LEVEL DRAFTED MOVEMENT

## 33a. THE PATH LINE — THREE DEFECTS UNDER ONE SYMPTOM
"The line stops at the stairs" was, in order of discovery:
1. **Before the hop it does not exist.** `TrySegment` rewrites the destination to the near anchor *before* the pather builds a path, so `curPath` correctly ends at the stairwell; the remainder lives only in the transit record.
2. **After the hop it exists a full Slot off screen.** `DrawPath` draws true world coordinates while `ABBelowDynamicDraw` draws the pawn at `DrawPos.z + drop`.
3. **⚠ AND THE PREVIEW ITSELF WAS REVERSED PER LEG** (found after #295). `Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`, so ascending index runs FORWARD; the first version iterated downward and appended every leg destination-first, drawing a zigzag out to the end of each leg and back. **Invisible on a straight corridor.**

**Fix.** `Patch_PawnPath_ABLiftPathLine` reimplements `DrawPath` lifted into the VIEW band (**reimplemented, not postfixed - the geometry is a chain**) and appends `ABTransitVisuals.DrawRemainingRoute`.
**⚠ VANILLA WAS ALREADY FULLY SUPPRESSED.** The prefix returns false and `DrawLinesBetweenTargets` is reimplemented too. A proposal to "suppress vanilla and draw our own" describes what is already shipped - **any remaining line bug is in OUR replacement.**
**⚠ THE FAR SIDE IS A REAL PATH, NOT A STRAIGHT LINE:** `FindPathNow` per same-band leg, walking the hop chain via `TryGetTransit`. **⚠ IT RUNS FROM A DRAW CALLBACK**, so it is lazy (selected pawns only), cached on the transit's NEAR ANCHOR, refreshed every 150 ticks. Keying on the anchor makes invalidation automatic. **⚠ `PawnPath` IS POOLED: copy nodes out, dispose immediately.**
**⚠ HOP SEGMENTS ARE SKIPPED EXPLICITLY VIA A `hops` INDEX LIST, NOT LEFT TO COLLAPSE.** The first version assumed both anchors lift onto the same point - true for RISERS (`(x, z ± Slot)`), FALSE for STAIRS, which pair arbitrarily, so a staircase with its ends in different corners drew a long diagonal streak for a journey of zero travel.
**⚠ EVERY LEG IS DELIBERATELY SAME-BAND, WHICH MAKES §32's GUARD A SAFETY NET** - a malformed hop chain gets an O(1) rejection instead of draining a band inside a draw call.

## 33b. ✅ FORCE-MOVE UP DID NOTHING — AND IT WAS DELIBERATE CODE. VERIFIED (#295).
`TryTranslateForOrder` rewrote any click whose band differed from the commanded pawns' band ONTO the pawns' band, so every upward order became a same-band shuffle. The see-through fallback beneath it only descends, so **DOWN worked only because cursor and pawn shared a band**.
**Fix: the VIEW BAND is the discriminator.** Clicking a cell on the level you are looking at means that level; the order passes through untranslated for the wormhole router. Gated on the existing `AnyCanReach`, so a stairless colony keeps the old behaviour. **Applies to ALL orders, by the user's call.**
**⚠ `Patch_RCellFinder_ABOrderedGotoBand` WAS ALREADY CORRECT** - it checks `CanReach` first and defers to the router. **Do not "fix" it too.**
**⚠ THE ORIGINAL TRANSLATION IS NOT A BUG AND MUST SURVIVE** - it is what fixed "three drafted pawns, only one moves".

## 33c. THE STAIR ANIMATION — REDESIGNED AFTER IT NEVER PLAYED
Pawn shrinks to 32% with a decaying shimmy over 18 ticks at the stairwell, then pops back out over 22 ticks on the far side.
**⚠ THE FIRST VERSION DROVE THE SHRINK OFF DISTANCE SPECIFICALLY TO AVOID DELAYING THE TELEPORT, AND COULD NEVER PLAY.** `ArriveRadius` is 3 and the shrink radius was 4, so the sweep carried the pawn the instant it entered the zone: peak progress 0.25 for one tick, a ~10% change. **Reported as "animations never play since pawns teleport before they can".**
**⚠ THE HOP IS NOW HELD, AND THE HOLD IS WHAT MAKES IT SAFE.** 18 ticks is shorter than opening a door. It is **bounded** (`ReadyToCarry` returns true unconditionally after OutTicks), **self-cancelling** (the record is refreshed only while the pawn is actually being offered for carry, so a pawn that walks away is swept), and **outlived by the existing 4000-tick timeout**.
**⚠ BOTH CARRY TRIGGERS CONSULT THE SAME GATE.** Gating only the sweep would make the animation play or not depending on how a pawn finished its leg - the exact failure §3 records. In `TryConsumeArrival`, returning true during the hold is the honest answer, not a trick: it means "do not tell the JobDriver it arrived, the journey is not over".
**⚠ IT COMPOSES WITH THE DEPTH CUE IN THE ONE EXISTING POSTFIX** (§8b). **⚠ AND THEIR GUARDS DIFFER:** `BelowDrawScale` is armed only inside the see-below pass, so early-returning on it would mean **a pawn taking the stairs on the band you are looking at never animates** - the common case.
**⚠ THE CACHED ATLAS BLIT EATS THIS TOO** past `ZoomRootSize` 18, so `disableCache` covers the stair case as well.
**⚠ `GetDrawParms` REACHES WORKER THREADS** - both dictionary probes are gated behind plain int counts.
